description: Central Province - The Early Childhood Development Charter - 2015 of Central Province Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette primarily concerns the establishment of a new legal framework (Early Childhood Development Charter) that repeals existing legislation, creates a regulatory unit, and sets forth registration, monitoring, and compliance requirements for early childhood development centers. It fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves new regulations, statutory instruments, and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes or specialized non-legal administrative matters.
